title: Threshold phenomena for least energy solutions of a doubly critical Neumann problem with a critical absorption term
summary: We investigate the existence and nonexistence of least energy solutions for a doubly critical Neumann problem with a critical absorption term. We consider a positive function $u$ defined on a smooth bounded domain $Ω\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ with $n\ge 5$, satisfying $-Δu + λu = u^{2^* - 1} -αu^{2^\sharp-1}$ inside $Ω$, with Neumann boundary condition $\nabla u\cdot ν= u^{2^\sharp -1}$ on $\partialΩ$, where $λ>0$, $α\ge0$, $2^*=\frac{2n}{n-2}$ is the critical Sobolev exponent and $2^\sharp=\frac{2(n-1)}{n-2}$ denotes the critical trace exponent.
